nameSource: data/US/stock_statement.parquet is the path that defeatbeta-api 0.0.62 (PyPI sdist, hugging_face_client.get_url_path with table stock_statement) builds, with columns symbol, report_date, item_name, item_value, finance_type, period_type (ticker.py _dataframe_to_stock_statements). The item_name diluted_eps is inferred from the package's snake_case item names, not read from the data. README.md is the Hugging Face dataset card path. Neither name was checked against the live repository.

rules.agreement: |dataset - SEC| <= tolerance and no sign error
rules.coverage: the missing US Q4 rows of q4-eps-missing-classification.json, reconciled with the financials files; covered = a matching dataset row with a usable diluted EPS value
rules.match: same symbol; the dataset report_date is within 7 days of the repo period end; the nearest date wins; an equidistant tie, two different values on the chosen date, or a null value does not match
rules.setA: US quarterly rows with fq 1 to 3, quarterly.src == "sec", a stored quarterly.values.epsDiluted and quarterly.derived != 1; the stored record does not name the SEC form
rules.setADerived: the same rows with quarterly.derived == 1, as a separate subset with the same measures
rules.setB: US Q4 rows with quarterly.epsQuality[i].epsDiluted == "A" and a stored quarterly.values.epsDiluted
rules.signError: both values nonzero and of opposite sign; a sign error is never agreement
rules.subtraction: annual diluted EPS minus (Q1 + Q2 + Q3) diluted EPS of the same fiscal year, from the repo's own files; testable only with exactly one annual row holding a value and exactly one row holding a value for each of Q1, Q2 and Q3; within = |dataset - subtraction| <= max(0.011, 0.005 * |subtraction|)
rules.wilson: lower bound of the 95% Wilson score interval (z = 1.959964) on agreements out of compared
rules.winner: the SEC value (the repo's value) always wins; the dataset is compared, never copied; no repo file is written
